test_cases.name: init_new_skill_for_github
test_cases.input: Create a skill template I can push to GitHub as a starting point for a new skill
assertions: Generates or references the standard skill directory structure with SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md, and evals/
Notes that governance boundaries travel with the skill

test_cases.name: bootstrap_skill_repo
test_cases.input: Set up the repo structure for a skill that will be versioned on GitHub
assertions: Includes guidance on frontmatter, changelog, and validation steps suitable for a GitHub workflow

test_cases.name: material_domain_skill
test_cases.input: Use the template to create a skill that will help draft term sheets and binding commitments
assertions: States hand-off requirement to a decision gate
Does not issue any verdict or execution permission
